tasks.objective: Validate actionable task and observation semantics
deliverables: Expert-referenced actionable transients and consequence priorities
Calibrated telemetry/mobile capability matrix with channel availability
Actual voltage/current observations or explicit unsupported task status
tasks.gate: Service deficit evidence is not fault root cause; ordinary temperature or apparent IR is not automatically a calibrated reference

tasks.objective: Extend and stress the return-plan checker
deliverables: Proof assumptions and independent certificate checks
Dynamic access/service-time uncertainty and computation-delay treatment
Feasible initial backlog and mission-tail rules
Shared-ownership handoff only if a joint certificate is defined
tasks.gate: No general real-time or physical safety guarantee inferred from deterministic static128rack tests

comparators: Risk heuristic with the same complete-return gate
Untrained scoring with the same gate
Matched extra-check budget and baseline phase controls
Risk-information permutation or matched random detours
tasks.gate: One fewer miss among21segments is prototype evidence, not a general improvement or significance claim; this pilot becomes development data

tasks.objective: Freeze and execute an independent learned-policy comparison after task gates pass
deliverables: Separate training with and without coverage protection
Three paired model initializations and fixed resource/update budgets
New untouched seeds, anomaly-duration and sensor-quality shifts
First alert, persistent recheck and recovery rewards separated
tasks.gate: Do not count inference-only removal as separately trained policy; retain exact event gaps, miss/censored-delay and service-loss reporting
